subject: use_vignette is not an exported object from namespace:devtools

messages.author: a8c21b37a1af97b3
messages.subject: use_vignette is not an exported object from namespace:devtools
parts:
Hi,

I'm working through Hadley's R packages, which has been a huge help so far.  Thanks Hadley!

For creating a vignette, it states that you should use:

devtools::use_vignette("my-vignette")

to create your first vignette.  However when I do, I get the error "use_vignette is not an exported object from namespace:devtools".

What am I doing wrong?  

Thanks in advance for any help.

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: use_vignette is not an exported object from namespace:devtools
parts:
You probably need the latest version - it's still percolating its way
around the build system on CRAN.

Hadley
